summary_md:
# #459 Sjukstugan LIVE

**Feed**: market-makers  
**Published**: 2026-11-26  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

A shortened 'sick bay' episode of Market Makers, recorded 24 Nov 2026. The hosts cover the GTA 6 launch, Anthropic's IPO (a good subscribe-and-flip trade for Swedish Nordnet clients), Jensen Huang's return as Nvidia CEO and the 30% Nvidia jump that came with it, and CrowdStrike's all-share bid for Zscaler. They also cover the rotation into richly valued defensive stocks. They argue that panic selloffs like this one have usually been followed by strong three-month returns. A long commodities segment describes a capitulation in gold, copper, PGMs, wheat and uranium. The guest is buying offshore drillers such as Transocean and a copper miners ETF, and is watching uranium and PGM names.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 RIG — Transocean | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Guest added to Transocean during the oil selloff and holds what he calls a full-size offshore position.

#### Reasoning

Offshore is trading like an oil-price derivative while fundamentals improve: consolidation, a tighter market, rising day rates, falling leverage and higher oil-major capex. Customers decide projects at $50-60 oil, far below the levels that would hurt. The guest admits he was wrong on the 2024 cycle and is sized below 2021-22 levels.

#### Sell Triggers

- 2008-style recession
- oil falls below $50-60 sanctioning levels
- day rates or contracting stall

> *"Så nu under den här nedgången jag tog tillfället i akt att öka i Transocean"*

---

### 🟡 BORR — Borr Drilling | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Guest did not add, but chairman Troim keeps buying, $30M recently. Part of the guest's offshore exposure.

#### Reasoning

Sizeable insider buying by the chairman supports the offshore bull case. The guest keeps his position but did not increase it.

#### Sell Triggers

- insider buying stops
- offshore cycle fails to turn

> *"Inte ökat i borr, men ordförande Trojm, han sitter fortfarande och köper."*

---

### 🟢 COPX — Global X Copper Miners ETF | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Copper is down 20% and miners 40%. Speculative positioning is at a three-year low while China faces shortages. The guest is buying slowly.

#### Reasoning

Western speculators have liquidated copper (Comex non-commercial positioning fell from $17B to $5B) while China's premium rises and Shanghai settles contracts in cash. Long-term electrification demand is intact. The guest is scaling in gradually because prices could halve again.

#### Sell Triggers

- full-blown recession
- easing of Trump tariffs on China drives further deleveraging
- China demand weakens

> *"Jag har börjat köpa lite i Coppex, det är en kopparminor ETF"*

---

### 🟠 SBSW — Sibanye Stillwater | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

PGMs are down 50% from the high and heavily shorted. Non-Russian supply is uneconomic. The guest is tempted to buy back in.

#### Reasoning

Platinum and palladium are washed out, with open interest exploding on short positions. Scrap and non-Russian production are uneconomic at these prices. Ukrainian strikes on Russian industry could hit supply. The guest owned it last year and is considering re-entry but has not bought.

#### Sell Triggers

- 2008-style recession
- further PGM price collapse

> *"Satt igång Sebani Stillwater SPSV förra året. Det kanske börjar bli dags att köpa in sig där igen."*

---

### 🟠 YCA — Yellow Cake | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Discount to NAV has widened to 30% while the uranium price keeps rising.

#### Reasoning

Uranium equities have collapsed 50% or more on their correlation with the AI trade, even as the spot price rises. A 30% NAV discount is an unusual dislocation, and the guest sees it as very interesting into 2027.

#### Sell Triggers

- uranium price starts falling
- AI capex unwind deepens

> *"Nu är det nere på 30% rabatt."*

---

### 🟠 CCJ — Cameco | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Largest uranium producer, cited during the sector washout while the uranium price keeps rising.

#### Reasoning

The guest sees the uranium sector as megautbombat (extremely washed out) because of its AI correlation, while the underlying price trends up. Cameco is named as the sector bellwether, but no position was stated.

#### Sell Triggers

- uranium price falls
- continued AI-capex risk-off

> *"Cameco som är den största spelaren i marknaden"*

---

### 🟠 7974 — Nintendo | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

A host calls Nintendo a repeat executor (Ocarina remake, Switch 2, films) whose stock is treated unfairly. He sees it as an interesting trade.

#### Reasoning

High quality, a strong game pipeline, film franchises and a Switch 2 sales boost from the acclaimed remake. The stock lags, which may be an opportunity. Swedish investors can access it via an Avanza tracker.

#### Sell Triggers

- Switch 2 sales disappoint
- memory cost inflation squeezes margins

> *"Så jag tror att Nintendo, det tycker jag är ett bolag som exekverar om och om igen."*

---

### ⛔ WMT — Walmart | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Trades at about 45x earnings with no growth as investors hide in defensives. Hosts call the valuation insane.

#### Reasoning

The rotation into defensives has pushed low-growth quality names to all-time highs and 2021-style multiples. Nothing justifies this beyond investors seeking safety, so the hosts see poor reward for buying here.

#### Sell Triggers

- growth re-accelerates to justify the multiple

> *"Nej, det är sinnessjuk värdering på Wallmart av de här."*

---

### ⛔ COST — Costco | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

About 50x earnings at an all-time high, driven by the flight to defensives.

#### Reasoning

Same thesis as Walmart: buying low-growth stocks at premium valuations does not feel like a winner. Defensives outperformed Nasdaq by 26% in October.

#### Sell Triggers

- risk-on reversal makes defensives cheaper

> *"Och det känns inte som en vinnare att köpa lågtillväxtaktier till den här premievärderingen."*

---

### ⛔ CRWD — CrowdStrike | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

The $44B all-stock Zscaler deal makes sense strategically, but neither company is profitable on the bottom line. A host finds them 'uninvestable'.

#### Reasoning

About 40% revenue growth and more than $10B combined ARR, but heavy stock-based compensation and no bottom-line profit. Scale lacks network effects, and synergies are unclear because Zscaler will run largely standalone.

#### Sell Triggers

- sustained GAAP profitability
- clear merger synergies

> *"Det känns ju konstigt att ingen av de här säkerhetsbolagen vill tjäna pengar på sista raden. Och det gör de ju lite oinvesterbara tycker jag."*

---
